She denies trouble with her breathing but endorses 5вЂ“10 lb of unintentional weight loss over the past few months. On physical exam, the patientвЂ™s fingernails appear flat and mild conjunctival pallor is noted. An upper barium esophagram shows an upper esophageal web. A complete blood count reveals:
Hb% 10 gm/dL
Total count (WBC) 11,000 /mm3
Differential count:
Neutrophile 70%
Lymphocytes 25%
Monocytes 5%
ESR 10 mm/hr
What is the most likely diagnosis?
